feedback_driven.quote: An update is committed only when paired evaluations reach consensus, requiring sufficient overall improvement and non-negative aggregate paired gain in every repeated evaluation.

persists_across_tasks.quote: Natural-language skills are textual procedural memories through which large language model (LLM) agents retain reusable task knowledge without updating model weights.
